_comment: Deterministic routing fixtures. tests/validate-model-routing.sh checks each against tier-table.json with no live model call. Scope: this file tests model and effort routing only. Agent failure, retry limits, circular delegation, missing connector or dependency, and final verification outcomes are orchestration-safety and verification scenarios that belong to engineering-orchestrator's anti-loop rules and to the final-verifier agent; they are not fabricated here before those systems exist.

base_tier_fixtures.description: Fix a typo in a log message.
Add a missing index on a read-heavy column.
Add a resend-invitation action to an existing feature.
Rename a widely used utility function across three services.
Discount code applies twice on a slow network at checkout.
